SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., USA, May, 2024 — Cornerstone Advisors, a prominent management and technology consultancy specializing in services for banks, credit unions, and fintech firms, announced the elevation of Steve Williams to the role of Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Steve Williams has been an integral part of Cornerstone Advisors since its inception in 2002, co-founding the company alongside Sommer and others. Under Sommer’s leadership as CEO, the company grew from a small team of eight to over 200 professionals and made strategic acquisitions of six companies. As the new CEO, Williams is poised to continue driving the firm’s growth and thought leadership initiatives.
